messages:
samira: Idea: neighbourhood dumpling crawl next Thursday after work + a tiny 'judge-off' for best dumpling. 3 stops, small teams, reusable chopsticks encouraged. :dumpling: :mag: 
ben: omg yes. love a crawl. what time were you thinking? 5:30 start?
olga: 5:30 works for me. can we keep it under 3 stops so people can still head home?
harry: i'm down but can we have a vegetarian-friendly route?
maria: i'll map out a veg-friendly route and ask the vendors if they want to do a small tasting portion for the judge-off.
samira: perfect. i'll draft a short signup form (teams of 3) and a dumpling scorecard (appearance, texture, flavor). quick poll: 5:30 or 6:00 start? react :one: for 5:30, :two: for 6:00.
ben: :one:
olga: :one: (earlier please)
harry: :two: (if later more people can join)
events: Note: please keep noise and crowding respectful to nearby shops. Events can get permits if >25 people.
dev-calendar-bot: Event created: "Dumpling Crawl & Judge-off" 3 Thu Jul 23 17:30-19:30 3 RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.example/e/dumpling-crawl-224567
```
Invite: Dumpling Crawl & Judge-off
When: Thu Jul 23, 17:30-19:30
Where: Meet at Building C lobby, then short walk to vendor route
Notes: Teams of up to 3. Bring cash/card for extras. Reusable chopsticks recommended. Label any allergies. RSVP by Mon Jul 20.
```
samira: i'll post the signup link in 10 and tag bus routes + walking directions. who wants to help carry paper scorecards?
ben: i can print 30 scorecards and bring a small clipboard.
olga: i'll volunteer to be an organizer at stop 2 (veg route contact).
harry: can we make a silly trophy (foil-wrapped wooden spoon)? i'll get craft stuff. :trophy:
maria: i'll confirm vendor tasting portions and ask if any need to close early.
samira: amazing. thanks all 3 i'll send RSVP reminder Monday and put the teams sheet in this thread. (reaction: :dumpling: :thumbsup:)
